newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ST Shipbuilding forms engineering unit.
newsitem.headline: ST Shipbuilding forms engineering unit.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Shipbuilding & Engineering Ltd (STSE), the marine arm of government-linked Singapore Technologies Group, said on Thursday it had formed a new subsidiary.
The new unit, STSE Engineering Services Pte Ltd, is formed as part of STSE's move into land-based engineering works, the company said in a statement.
It will act as a main contractor, developer and subcontractor of engineering and engineering related works and to provide turnkey engineering solutions.
Its authorised and paid-up capital are Singapore $1.0 million and S$2 respectively.
